description: Free. Young pump.fun coins (under three days old, from the trending lists) screened now on the preset chart traders use: 12-hour volume 2-5x the market cap, the top 10 holders 30% or less, under 15% of the supply bought in the first 10 seconds, a trade a second or more, no volume-bot shape. pass: all five; near: one or two missed, named. Refreshed every minute. For: coins that pass a screener, Axiom-style filters, volume and holders checks across coins. Often none pass; a screen, not a recommendation; then check_coin on a mint.
name: screener
